text: モンスターボールだ　なかに　ポケモンが　はいってるぞ！

structure.jp: なかに　ポケモンが　はいってるぞ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: いる after a て-form verb can say something happened and is still that way. てる is the shortened spoken form. はいってる = 'is inside'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, strong way of pointing something out. はいってるぞ = 'it's in there, hey!'.
